implementation.scope: Ordinary Float Rate/Increase under a qualified scalar or numeric Float map, only at root ordered-map scope or immediately below a collecting ordinary aggregate.
implementation.proof: Exact active call node, raw selector, kind and nanosecond range, ordered/map identity, one physical source and complete checked current label bytes.
implementation.metadata: Early projection removes reserved metadata when either rate child or map does; delayed projection retains it until existing final cleanup. Raw empty labels preserved.
implementation.unchanged: All existing Instant admissions, rate arithmetic/diagnostics/credits, Map values/filtering, finalizer, native/absent/extended/other-operation paths. No cache, field, public interface, provider promise or format.
implementation.consumer_limit: Nested maps and other new Rate consumer shapes use existing copying; outer descriptor preparation can otherwise rematerialize borrowed labels.

changing_labels.scope: Combined counters across eight expressions; all thresholds compare complete outcomes/read counts. Not per-expression totals.

prospective_plan.timing_summary: median of per-shape paired block medians; family median of individual ratios
prospective_plan.persistent_failure: Reject; no unchanged retry or relaxed gate.
prospective_plan.resources: Complete results/physical observations exact; measured equal-label work and category current/peak/acquired nonincreasing, meaningful traffic gain. Changed-label fallback comparison work counted separately.
prospective_plan.compiled_cost: Proportional66; fixed text/data/BSS distinct from query memory.
prospective_plan.limits: Finite synthetic measurements, not universal/live/concurrent/RSS/physicalARM guarantees.

timing.scope: Paired shared-host native queries; all blocks and absolute spread retained, not a universal speed guarantee.

resources.work: Nonincreasing in equal-label early/timing/broad pairs. Changed-label fallback may add checked comparison work.
resources.memory: All measured category acquired/current/peak nonincreasing; allocation traffic differs from live peak. Stack/RSS unmeasured.

compiled_scope: Standalone default C consumers; fixed text/data/BSS under66, not per-query RAM or full Netdata executable.

rejected_broad_candidate.cause: Outer descriptor preparation can compare borrowed labels then copy them into a new descriptor; exact208unit decomposition unmeasured.
rejected_broad_candidate.disposition: Rejected; separate consumer-qualified source, unchanged frozen cases/repetitions/gates. No unchanged retry or relaxed threshold.

source_phases: Accepted223 fixtures/broad captures retain146exact runtime/Cargo bindings plus exact inverse of one cfg(test) parity spelling. Default C baselines147exact. Initial broad candidate-final failed one work gate; candidate-narrow adds positive consumer proof and nested regression. All accepted qualification binds candidate-narrow.
limitations: Finite synthetic evidence, not arbitrary-input equivalence, live Netdata, concurrent throughput, process RSS or physical ARM performance.
The32start-reset/overlap corpus cases use server-default and ignore starts; enabled overlap is separately exercised by focused options(delayed).
Diagnostic/native unit pairs compare full enabled/disabled snapshots; not every incidental warning or native path is independently asserted.
